The '''Flesh Raider Chieftain''' was a [[Flesh Raider]] who commanded several others of his [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Flesh Raider uprising]]<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> of [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> A Flesh Raider with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark grey skin, the Chieftain was assigned with subordinates to guard the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]] protecting the main Flesh Raider command base. However, the Chieftain and the soldiers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] when the [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|raided the mountain caves]] to destroy the generator.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Flesh Raider Chieftain appears in [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class quest "The Face of the Enemy".<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
